name: Hans123 Trader v2
summary: Hans123 Trader v2 is a classic session breakout EA that places pending orders at the high and low of an initial time window (typically the Asian/London session overlap). When price breaks out of the established range, the pending order is triggered and the trade is managed with a fixed take-profit and stop-loss.
summary_zh: Hans123 Trader v2是一个经典的时段突破EA，它在初始时间窗口（通常是亚洲/伦敦时段重叠期）的最高价和最低价处放置挂单。当价格突破已确立的区间时，挂单被触发，交易通过固定的止盈和止损进行管理。
strategy_analysis: Hans123策略是一个著名的时段突破策略，其核心概念是在市场波动较小的时段建立价格区间，然后等待突破入场。入场条件：在指定时间段（通常是凌晨时段）的最高价上方设置买入止损单，在最低价下方设置卖出止损单。出场条件：固定的止盈和止损水平，当一方被触发后取消另一方的挂单（OCO逻辑）。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面有最大持仓限制和每日最大交易次数限制。该策略的逻辑基础是：盘整时段积累的能量在突破时会释放出趋势行情。
strategy_analysis_en: The Hans123 strategy is a well-known session breakout approach whose core concept is to establish a price range during a low-volatility period and then enter on a breakout. Entry conditions: a buy stop order is placed above the highest price of a designated time window (typically the early Asian/London session), and a sell stop order is placed below the lowest price. Exit conditions: fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with OCO (One Cancels the Other) logic so that when one side is triggered, the opposite pending order is cancelled. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an equity-based calculation. Money management includes maximum position limits and daily trade count caps. The strategy's underlying logic is that consolidation during quiet sessions accumulates energy that releases as trending moves upon breakout.

parameters.description_en: Session end time for breakout range termination

parameters.description_en: Manage positions with specific magic number only; 0 manages all

pros: 逻辑清晰简单，基于经典的时段突破原理，易于理解和验证
风险可控，使用固定止损止盈，每笔交易的风险是已知的
OCO机制确保不会同时持有多空仓位，降低了双向持仓风险
pros_en: Clear and simple logic based on a classic session breakout principle, easy to understand and verify
Risk is controlled with fixed stop-loss and take-profit, risk per trade is known in advance
OCO mechanism ensures no simultaneous long and short positions, reducing hedging risk
cons: 在震荡行情中容易被假突破触发止损
固定止损止盈不考虑市场波动率变化，在不同行情下表现差异大
时段参数固定，不能自适应不同交易品种和市场条件
cons_en: Susceptible to false breakout triggers resulting in stop-loss hits during ranging markets
Fixed SL/TP does not account for market volatility changes, leading to inconsistent performance across different market conditions
Session parameters are hardcoded and cannot adapt to different instruments or market conditions
improvements: 引入ATR动态调整止损止盈，适应不同波动率环境
加入突破确认机制（如突破后回踩确认或成交量确认），减少假突破
增加移动止损功能，在有利行情中锁定更多利润
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to different volatility environments
Add breakout confirmation mechanisms (e.g., pullback confirmation or volume confirmation) to reduce false breakouts
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in more profit during favorable moves

risk_points: 时段参数设置不当可能导致在低流动性时段交易，增加滑点风险
固定止损可能在极端行情下不足以覆盖实际亏损
risk_points_en: Improper session parameter settings may lead to trading during low liquidity periods, increasing slippage risk
Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to cover actual losses during extreme market conditions
